name: Makise Mizuho
source:
The main character's childhood friend. She is the wife of an ordinary businessman. She is a motherly and gentle woman, but her body is extremely sensitive, and when it catches fire, she can't be put out.

She has been married for 4 years.

[From archived [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161027201843/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/nikutuma/nikutuma_index.html]official site[/url]]
